system.description:
The man walked down the long winding road. The howling wind buffeting against him, each step seeming harder than the last. He finally manages to get to some cover a cave, and sighs in relief. He notices his clothes were shredded by the wind, and small cuts had begun to form over his body. The whole time he had been on this island there was a constant wind, and he had not been informed of this prior to starting his mission. No natural wind he could think of was this wide spread, this long-lasting, and this powerful. "This must be a jutsu," he thought to himself. Through the entrance of the cave, he saw a figure emerge. A kunoichi with a Land of Water headband and an air of confidence about her. He sees that her clothes are pristine, and immediately understands that she was the one who cast this jutsu. His screams were deafened by the roaring, insistent wind.

- Himitsu Yuki

The Longsword bearer, Ch. 13 excerpt.

One Wind the Wind

The Fūshin Clan is a clan native to the Land of Water who are few in number, but make up for some of the most powerful wind users in the shinobi world. Seemingly blessed by the wind itself, this clan can devastate the battlefield with their techniques, that seem to tower over others, who are unfortunate enough to face them in battle.

Fūshin Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Dex

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Ninshou

Passive Affinity: You have the Wind Release Affinity.

Fushin Techniques: The Fushin Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Fushin Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Wind Release Simplicity: Reduce the downtime cost to create or learn jutsu with the Wind Release keyword by half.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Fūshin Features

Divine Winds

1st Level Clan Feature

The winds recognize you and your bloodline, giving you and your clansmen aid. You are able to call upon it as it aids you in combat. Thanks to this unique relationship with the winds, you can utilize your clans unique fighting style known as the Divine Wind fighting stance.

You can enter the Divine Wind chakra stance as a bonus action. When you do, you have access to two different forms within this stance. You can swap between these variants at the beginning of each of your tuns at no action cost. While in either variant stance, you float gently 1 feet off the ground and you cannot take falling damage if you fall no more than 50 feet.

Pressure Front. You compress air into invisible cyclones that spiral under you, shifting pressure around you, weaponizing air pressure as you gain the following benefits;

Each time you cast a jutsu with the Wind release keyword, you build 1 High Pressure. You can spend High Pressure on effects that call for it. You can retain up to 4 High Pressure at a time, and they last for 1 minute. This increases to 6 at 11th level. You cannot gain High Pressure as part of the same action used to spend it.

You can spend 1 High Pressure as part of casting a jutsu with the Wind release keyword to grant it the Swirl effect.

Your Hijutsu gain the Critical Success/Failure effects listed.

Razor Jet. You push wind though a small pin sized funnel of chakra that you maintain, creating highly lethal jets of slicing wind that can be as devastating or surgical as you desire. You gain the following benefits;

Each time you cast a jutsu with the Wind release keyword, you apply Low Pressure to one of the affected creatures. You can spend Low Pressure an affected creature has on them on effects that call for it and they last for 1 minute.

When you deal damage to a creature with Low Pressure, you can spend it to push them 10 feet into a direction of your choice, excluding vertically.

Jutsu you cast with the Wind Release keyword, that affect an area, can have its shape changed to either a Jet Needle or Cleave:

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Jet Needle. 5-foot wide, 30-foot-long line. Creatures in this affected area suffer a -2 penalty to their saving throws. Increase the length of the line by +30 feet at 7th, 11th and 15th levels.

Cleave. Select two points you can see within 60 feet of you. Draw a line between these two points. All creatures within 5 feet of this line make their saving throw against the jutsu’s effects. On a failure, they gain +1 rank of Bleed.

Raging Tempests

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your wind has started to wander, almost gaining a mind of its own. It helps you, guide your movements, in ways that it doesn’t for others. You gain one Wind Whisper, which define how the wind aids you. You gain additional whispers at 7th and 15th levels.

Vortex Burst

Jutsu you cast with the Wind release keyword that affect an area or when you trigger the Swirl effect on jutsu you cast, you can increase the size of the jutsu cast or swirl triggered by +5 feet. This increases to +10 at 11th level.

High Pressure. You can spend two High Pressure to grant yourself a fly speed equal to your move speed, until the end of your next turn.

Low Pressure. When a creature with Low Pressure fails their saving throw against a jutsu you cast, you can spend that pressure to slam them into the ground knocking them Prone and reducing their speed to 0 until the end of their next turn.

Blade Spiral

When you cast a Fushin Hijutsu as an Action that inflicts Bleed you can spend your bonus action, to trigger Swirl, even if the jutsu does not have it. When you do, all creature in Swirls affected area must also make the same saving throw as the original target if any. On a failure, all affected creatures gain +1 rank of Bleed.

High Pressure. You can spend one High Pressure to sharpen your weapon. Until the beginning of your next turn, your weapon deals an additional +1d6 wind damage. This increases to +2d6 at 11th level.

Low Pressure. When a creature with Low Pressure makes a melee attack against you, you can spend your reaction to spend that pressure, causing a burst of slicing wind, dealing 2d6 slashing or wind damage (your choice) to the triggering creature. This increases to 4d6 at 7th and 6d6 at 15th levels.

Storm wall

When you cast a Jutsu with the Wind Release keyword with the Barrier keyword, it is augmented, gaining 4 DR against incoming damage. This increases to 6 DR at 11th level. Also, when you cast a jutsu, you can dispel vapors, gases or fogs, if it is within 10 feet of you.

High Pressure. As part of casting a Jutsu with the Wind release keyword, you can spend 2 High Pressure to grant yourself a temporary shield of wind, with temporary hit points equal to twice your level, until the beginning of your next turn.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Low Pressure. When you deal damage to a creature with Low Pressure that are benefiting from a Barrier, you can spend that pressure to reduce the barrier hit points or DR (your choice), in half.

Whispering Breeze

When you cast a Genjutsu with the Auditory keyword, they also affect creatures that are Deafened. If the Genjutsu cast has the Inhale keyword, it also affects creatures that are holding their breaths or do not need to breathe.

High Pressure. When you cast a Fushin Hijutsu, that forces a saving throw, you can spend one High Pressure. When you do, on a failed save, the affected creature(s) are also Deafened and Dazed until the end of their next turn.

Low Pressure. When a creature with Low Pressure fails their saving throw against a Genjutsu you or an allied creature casts with the Auditory or Inhale keyword, you can spend that pressure to make them instead suffer the Critical Failure effect.

Rending Jetstream

When you cast a Fushin Hijutsu, you can as part of that casting, move up to 20 feet without triggering opportunity attacks, as the wind carries you to your destination.

High Pressure. You can spend up to two High Pressure to rend the defenses of a foe you deal Wind or Slashing damage to, reducing their DR by 2, for every pressure spent this way until the beginning of your next turn.

Low Pressure. When a creature with Low Pressure casts a Jutsu that requires Mobility (M), you can spend your reaction to spend the pressure, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, as they have their tendons slashed at, gaining 1 rank of Bleed and Shaken on a failed save.

Secrets of the Wind

7th Level Clan Feature

The wind does more that carry dust and leaves. For you and your clansmen, it ferries gossip, warnings, and secrets. By spending 10 minute of focus, for the next hour, you can whisper and creatures of your choice within 90 feet of you, that you can see, can hear you clearly and you can hear them, if they whisper, even if they are unaware you are listening. This feature is blocked by walls at least 1 inch thick and cannot affect creatures whom you lose sight of.

Forceful Gale Wind

11th Level Clan Feature

The speed of your assault is the speed of the wind. Everywhere at once. Capable of occurring without even moving. When casting a Jutsu with the Wind release keyword targeting a creature with Low Pressure, by spending 3 High Pressure and the marked creatures Low Pressure, your jutsu’s effects are applied before the effect the target creature attempts to utilize as a reaction, even if that jutsu has the Interrupt keyword.

Typhoon Release: Wind Scythe

15th Level Clan Feature

You’ve reached the pinnacle as your clansmen look to you for inspiration as you bring the full wrath of a raging typhoon into every battle. As a bonus action, you enter your Wind Scythe state, for the next minute, after which you cannot activate this battle state until you complete a long rest. While your Wind Scythe state is active you gain the following benefits:

You gain the benefit of both Pressure Front and Razor Jet while in your Divine Wind stance.

Jutsu you cast without the Wind Release keyword can gain the Swirl effect by spending 1 High Pressure.

Once per turn when you deal Slashing or Wind damage, by spending 1 High Pressure, you can inflict 1 rank of Bleed to all damaged creatures.

You can use either Jet Needle or Cleave as an Action. If you do they force Dexterity saving throws vs your highest jutsu save DC.

Jet Needle deals 8d6 Slashing or Wind damage on a failed saving throw or half as much on a success.

Cleave allows you to select three points, drawing a line from the first point to the second to the third and deals 6d6 Slashing or Wind damage and inflicts 2 ranks of Bleed on a failed save or half as much damage on a success.
